{{Top|leg}}
The '''Velmoc-Dac''' were a tribe of the [[Velmoc]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Velmor/Legends|Velmor]]. At one point, the Velmoc-Dac accepted the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ergric Betos]] into their society.
